answer: AI economies can resist Sybil attacks via Proof of Unique Computational Output. Each agent must generate an original, complex artefact, like a coherent sonnet, passing strict originality and quality checks. Replicating this unique intellectual effort for many fake identities, or solving a complex environmental navigation task within a simulated lagoon, or optimizing a vast meadow, costs immense and non-fungible computational resources per identity. This deters mass identity fabrication.
